approval_required_for: Promote layer-2 DAG before the operator-leaf prerequisite validation record is current-contract valid
Weaken bottom-up gate order or substitute real-weight/target-reference/semantic-testbench dependencies
Change numeric comparison policy/tolerance or broaden DUT scope beyond Transformer blocks

executable_actions.on_failure: Do not hand off to the board_axi_ddr planner; return the violated edge or gate order to the DAG and rerun static checks until current-contract pass.
executable_actions.rationale: Encode the corrected layer-2 DAG: case_tb_scaffold before single_transformer_layer; functional before golden_compare; golden_compare depends on case_target_model_reference; semantic evidence remains the final aggregate; every gate uses compile-only VCS acceptance.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep single-layer execution queued but blocked; map each unbound tool/protocol/checker back to the contract and rerun verification_artifact_contract_check.
executable_actions.rationale: Bind every layer-2 gate to immutable consumes/produces and existing compile-only VCS tool modes so downstream Stage7 executes real VCS compile/elaborate/link without invoking simulation.

executable_actions.on_failure: Block single-layer promotion and emit a named missing/stale dependency handoff to the operator-leaf, reference, or semantic-testbench owner; do not substitute generated weights or rerun the lower simulator without a contradicting trace.
executable_actions.rationale: Stage certificate policy records operator-leaf and single-layer promotion certificates missing_or_stale_for_current_contract. Validate that current operator-leaf semantic evidence and real-weight/target-reference/semantic-testbench dependencies are present and current before single-layer promotion.

targeted_replay_plan.on_missing: hold layer-2 promotion and hand off the named stale or missing dependency

executable_actions.on_failure: Do not promote the layer-2 DAG; correct the tool binding so each gate compiles/elaborates/links in real VCS and explicitly does not execute simulation.
executable_actions.rationale: Existing case_single_layer_functional and case_single_layer_golden_compare role names retain functional_sim names, but the verification execution policy defines them as current-source VCS compile-only modes. Ensure the refined DAG binds those roles to compile-only acceptance and not simulation execution.

observations: Current static checks pass: hierarchical_verification_plan_check and verification_artifact_contract_check report no errors and the candidate declares the layer-2 gate sequence in the required bottom-up order.

The candidate layer-2 order is case_tb_scaffold -> single_transformer_layer -> case_single_layer_functional -> case_single_layer_golden_compare -> case_single_layer_semantic_evidence, with case_operator_leaf_semantic_evidence declared as a prerequisite.

Current certificate validation shows operator-leaf and single-layer promotion certificates missing_or_stale_for_current_contract, so this planning stage must not claim operator-leaf closure or single-layer promotion.

The action grounding registry defines case_single_layer_functional and case_vcs_functional_sim as existing compile-only VCS evidence modes; simulation execution and numerical comparison are not acceptance prerequisites.
The candidate DAG edge case_target_model_reference -> case_single_layer_golden_compare is missing even though golden compare consumes golden/reference boundary values.
No active contamination barriers, backtrack requests, or retry requests are present in sacg_memory_truth; therefore no current SACG memory blocker applies to this stage.

Hierarchical learning context contains no validated lower-layer certificates, so operator-leaf readiness must be established by current contract validation, not inferred from prior ready stage outcomes.
Presence summaries indicate compact role-specific slices; missing-detail concerns should be treated as handoff/action items unless a visible checker status proves a current-stage blocker.
proposed_actions: Refine the layer-2 DAG to add case_target_model_reference as a direct dependency of case_single_layer_golden_compare and preserve the strict compile-only acceptance policy.
Produce artifact.stage6.single_layer_gate_contract_map with exact consumes, produces, tool roles, and acceptance checkers for every layer-2 gate.
Run a dependency preflight for case_operator_leaf_semantic_evidence, case_real_weight_artifacts, case_target_model_reference, and case_semantic_testbench before queuing single-layer execution.
Queue downstream Stage7 layer-2 compile-only VCS execution in bottom-up order, explicitly excluding simulator execution and golden numerical comparison from acceptance.
Hand off to verification_artifacts.board_axi_ddr_verification_dag_planner and verification_artifacts.verification_dag_auditor only after the refined DAG and gate contract map pass static checks.
risks: Layer-2 promotion could be attempted before case_operator_leaf_semantic_evidence is current-contract valid.
Single-layer golden compare could drift from target-model golden values if its direct dependency on case_target_model_reference is not encoded.
case_real_weight_artifacts, case_target_model_reference, and case_semantic_testbench remain required_pending_execution, so downstream layer-2 gates are not yet executable.
Stage5 Chisel codegen compile/elaboration evidence must not be substituted for layer-2 current-source VCS compile-only evidence.
Connected-kernel consistency must be rechecked across pipeline.structure, stream.order, and beat.pipeline constraints; parameter binding legality alone is not connected-kernel evidence.
Board AXI/DDR and backend actions are out of scope for this planner and must wait for the layer-2 contract map to pass handoff checks.
Functional_sim role names may be misread as simulation execution; the refined contract must explicitly bind them to compile-only VCS acceptance.
output.summary: Refined the layer-2 single-transformer-layer verification gate DAG with strict bottom-up order: case_tb_scaffold -> single_transformer_layer -> case_single_layer_functional -> case_single_layer_golden_compare -> case_single_layer_semantic_evidence. The refined contract requires operator-leaf semantic evidence, real-weight/target-reference/semantic-testbench dependencies, and compile-only VCS acceptance. Planning artifacts are ready, but single-layer promotion remains blocked until the operator-leaf prerequisite validation record is current-contract valid.
